title: ArenaFlow: From Trajectory Ranking to Hierarchical Credit Propagation for Open-Ended Agent RL
abstract: arXiv:2609.21378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has substantially improved large language model (LLM) agents in verifiable domains, but remains difficult to apply to open-ended agent tasks, where solutions are diverse and reliable scalar rewards are hard to obtain. Recent pairwise evaluation methods alleviate reward discrimination collapse by replacing pointwise scoring with relative preferences. However, they still compress rich comparative feedback into a single trajectory-level reward, obscuring decisive intermediate steps and preventing successful behaviors from being consolidated into reusable skills. We propose ArenaFlow, a hierarchical credit propagation framework for open-ended agent reinforcement learning. ArenaFlow leverages tournament-based relative ranking to derive trajectory-level reward signals. translated_title: ArenaFlow：从轨迹排序到分层信用传播的开放式智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习已在可验证领域显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）智能体的表现，但难以应用于开放式智能体任务，因为此类任务的解决方案多样且难以获得可靠的标量奖励。近期的成对比较评估方法通过以相对偏好取代逐点打分，缓解了奖励区分度崩塌的问题。然而，这些方法仍将丰富的比较反馈压缩为单一的轨迹级奖励，掩盖了决定性的中间步骤，并阻碍了成功行为被巩固为可复用的技能。我们提出 ArenaFlow，一个面向开放式智能体强化学习的分层信用传播框架。ArenaFlow 利用基于锦标赛的相对排序来推导轨迹级奖励信号，并进一步为每次比较配备结构化的反思式评估，从而揭示三类监督信号：关键成功步骤、可复用策略……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ArenaFlow 提出了一种分层信用传播框架，通过锦标赛式相对排序与结构化反思评估，将轨迹级比较反馈细化为关键成功步骤和可复用策略等多层次监督信号，从而突破开放式智能体强化学习中可靠奖励难以获取的瓶颈。
